dogecoin.text:
Coincidence?

Dogecoin (DOGE)
Department of Government Efficiency (also DOGE)

That Musk is connected to both Dogecoin (DOGE) and the Dept. of Government Efficiency (also DOGE) raises significant legal and ethical concerns.

Instead of putting the richest man in charge of the Dept. of GE, we’d all be better off with a cap on wealth and a cap on oil and gas. https://t.co/v0d1DVG0f3
